crossRefs.note: They went and came to the mountain, and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had returned. The pursuers sought…
David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul…
David went up from there, and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

translations.web: She said to them, “Go to the mountain, lest the pursuers find you. Hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers have returned. Afterward, you may go your way.”
translations.bsb: “Go to the hill country,” she said, “so that your pursuers will not find you. Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned; then go on your way.”
translations.kjv: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers meet you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
translations.asv: And she said unto them, Get you to the mountain, lest the pursuers light upon you; and hide yourselves there three days, until the pursuers be returned: and afterward may ye go your way.
